text:
incident-bot: PAGED: gcp-interconnect-egress-alert — >= 30% packet loss on interconnect attachments in asia-southeast1 affecting private connectivity to customer VPCs. Auto-escalation to oncall.

maria: ack — I'm oncall. What’s the impact? any customer 503s or just latency spikes?

joel: seeing BGP resets to multiple partner routers, sessions flapping. traceroute shows TTL cascade at /asia-southeast1/interconnect-edge.

joel: quick repro: `mtr -c 50 -w 10.64.3.1` -> 35-60% packet loss through interconnect edge, local internal routes fine.

maria: @joel are dedicated customers (Dedicated + Private) impacted or only Private deployments w/ Interconnect attachments?

joel: primarily Private that use VLAN attachments/Partner Interconnect. Dedicated reserved capacity (our managed instances) are still reachable via public egress+NAT, but inference latencies for some private tenants are severe and some RPCs timing out (5xx).

amy: support seeing 3 customers flagged: CUST-112, CUST-279, CUST-331 — all private-hosted with interconnect. Logged as "degraded - inference timeouts" on customer portal. Drafting status update now.

amy: Suggested status message: "We're investigating increased packet loss between our Private connectors in asia-southeast1 and upstream GCP interconnect partners. Some private deployments may see higher latencies or failed requests. We will post updates every 30m." ok to post?

maria: yes post it. @customer-success coordinate emails for the three affected accounts, include mitigation steps (switch to fallback region or public API temporarily).

sre-bot: runbook step 1 executed: toggle-route-preference -> set secondary-egress true

joel: trying controlled reroute to secondary Interconnect and cross-region steering for affected private attachments. Command run:
```
gcloud compute interconnects attachments update attach-123 --region=asia-southeast1 --preferred-availability=secondary
```

joel: also updating BGP hold-time temporarily to reduce flaps:
```
bgp session set hold-time 90
```

maria: any signs GCP has an incident on their side? @gcp-status-bot?

gcp-status-bot: GCP Notification: Investigating — Packet loss affecting partner interconnects in asia-southeast1. https://status.cloud.google.com/incident/12345

maria: good, at least it's not just us. @joel how long to steer traffic? estimate 10-12m for route convergence.

joel: started steering. Monitoring token-level metrics and private connector health. Prometheus alert firing: private_connector_p50_latency x5 for three ids.

amy: customers alerted, one asks for ETA. told them ~30-45m and fallback instructions.

maria: plan: 1) continue steering to secondary interconnect 2) if not stable in 30m, failover affected customers to public-hosted endpoints (we have customer-specific NATs) and offer temporary rate-limits 3) prepare incident report and postmortem.

luis: I'm covering the next shift. Maria handing off at 12:30 UTC. TL;DR for handoff: routing steering in progress, GCP investigating, 3 affected private tenants, support comms in flight, metrics improving slightly but still noisy.

maria: handing off to @luis now. Logged action items in incident ticket INC-5872. Key: keep customer fallback ready, don't apply broad ACL changes without testing.

luis: ack — I'll monitor and coordinate with GCP if needed. @joel leave a runbook snippet of exact commands you used.

joel: pasted into ticket: `gcloud ... attachments update` + `bgp session set hold-time` + `ip route replace` for quick cross-region tunnel:
```
ip route replace 10.20.0.0/16 via 35.201.12.4 dev tun0
```

sre-bot: Alert suppressed: duplicate private_connector_latency for CUST-279 (manual suppression by luis)

gcp-status-bot: Update: GCP reports partial convergence after partner reconfigs, working on full restoration.

luis: seeing p95 drop from 3.1s -> 1.8s for CUST-112 after steer. Still elevated vs baseline 180ms. Will keep fallback plan ready.

amy: support updated customers at +30m. Two requested immediate fallback; one asked to wait.

luis: started executing fallback for CUST-331 to public endpoint, steps:
1) create temporary service account + token
2) update connector config to point at public API endpoint
3) set rate limits to 70% of normal to be safe

luis: fallback completed for CUST-331, they report normal throughput and lower error rates. Marked as mitigated.

gcp-status-bot: Resolved: Partner interconnect packet loss resolved at 1769807800, routes converged. Full confirmation pending.

maria: noted. Please keep monitoring for 2 hours, and keep postmortem notes in INC-5872. We'll need RCA on why our interconnect failover didn't fully mask impact for private tenants.

joel: initial notes for RCA: partner vendor M2 had partial BGP flap, our route preference tie-breaker prioritized primary until manual steer. Need a pre-wired fast-fail policy in routing controller.

customer-success: customers that used fallback have been offered credit and technical support to migrate connectors to multi-attachment config.

luis: closing handoff. If anything new, page me directly. Otherwise I'll draft mitigation timeline and attach to the ticket.

incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigated -> partial, postmortem required. End of thread.
